info.title: Master Portal / Spark ERP Backend API
info.description: Comprehensive OpenAPI 3.0 documentation for all backend routes of Spark ERP Multi-School Management System.

tags.name: Authentication APIs
tags.description: User login, registration, password management, profile & tokens

tags.name: User Management APIs
tags.description: User accounts, teachers, students, parents, staff directory

tags.name: Company Management APIs
tags.description: Schools, classes, sections, houses, academic settings

tags.name: Financial APIs
tags.description: Billing, fee categories, fee structures, collections, receipts, salaries, invoices, payments, e-commerce cart/orders

tags.name: CRUD APIs
tags.description: Library books, borrowings, inventory items, transport routes, vehicles, drivers

tags.name: Business Logic APIs
tags.description: Student & teacher attendance, exams, quizzes, syllabus, assignments, schedules, announcements, messages, doubts, notes

tags.name: File Upload and Download APIs
tags.description: Document, avatar, photo, and media file uploads & Cloudinary integration

tags.name: Admin APIs
tags.description: Administrative quizzes, analytics, system maintenance, and bulk operations

tags.name: System / Health APIs
tags.description: Root health check, uptime, CORS validation

tags.name: Other APIs
tags.description: Admissions, dormitories, student transport mappings, AI assistant, promo codes, ads
